findings.summary: The proposed battery is fail-closed and implementation-ready: eight source-bound clean relations, eleven mapped mutation challenges, same-adapter lineage disclosure, deterministic semantic replay, and total terminal routing are specified. This is a design verdict only and is not an executed PR-172 self-consistency result.

summary: A minimal fail-closed PR-172 design is ready: eight preregistered relations exercise the two named production adapters, eleven explicit mutants guard against false green, replay compares a semantic digest in two fresh processes, and terminal routing can emit only internal C1 self-consistency or a blocked/error outcome. This design result is not an executed PR-172 battery and cannot itself support a PR-172 pass.

verdicts.rationale: The relation set is non-degenerate, source-bound, lineage-honest, mutation-complete for the registered defect classes, and total over pass, violation, false-green, runtime-blocked, and harness-invalid outcomes.

mutation_execution_contract.method: execute each mutant in an isolated imported namespace or explicit dependency-injection seam; never edit the tracked adapter source
requirements: every mutant is killed by at least one declared relation
the clean adapter passes before its mutants are interpreted
missing, skipped, xfailed, crashed-without-envelope, or unmapped mutations are survivors
mutation IDs, strengths, fixtures, and mappings are immutable after any clean or mutant output is viewed

lineage_contract.lineage_kind: same-production-adapter metamorphic pair with analytic transform relation
lineage_contract.pr123_role: dependency supplies lineage and mutation-discipline precedent only
lineage_contract.fail_condition: any result reports numerical-oracle independence, external replication, or two-oracle support from the base/transformed pair

schema_validation: exact top-level and nested key sets; unknown keys fail
reject bool where an integer/count is required
reject NaN, infinity, shape drift, dtype drift, duplicate IDs, missing IDs, and extra IDs
store primitive output arrays as shape, dtype, little-endian byte hash, and float.hex values needed to recompute residuals
recompute relation verdicts, mutation kills, per-adapter state, and terminal token from primitives; never trust caller-supplied derived booleans
require all source and configuration hashes to match the frozen registry

deterministic_replay.semantic_digest: SHA-256 of canonical JSON over all source bindings, fixture/config fields, primitive outputs, residuals, mutation outcomes, and terminal state
deterministic_replay.exclusion_rule: the allowlist is frozen in the spec; no scientific or pass/fail field may be excluded
deterministic_replay.pass_condition: both fresh processes return zero, validate exact schemas, and produce identical semantic digests
deterministic_replay.failure_disposition: ERROR_HARNESS_INVALID; no estimator pass is emitted

routes.when: schema, registry, fixture, canonicalization, replay, or recomputation contract fails
a frozen source hash drifts or a required runtime/import is unavailable
any clean relation fails; block only the implicated adapter plus the overall PR-172 pass
all clean relations pass but any registered mutant is not demonstrably killed
all 8 clean relations pass, all 11 mutants execute and are killed, both replay digests match, and all metadata/claim gates pass

terminal_routing.mixed_adapter_rule: retain per-adapter states, but any blocked/failed adapter prevents the overall PASS token
terminal_routing.forbidden_terminal_inference: never translate PASS_SELF_CONSISTENCY_C1 into data adequacy, physics correctness, detection, geometry evidence, or family identification

proposed_changes: Freeze the eight relations, two literal fixtures, tolerances, eleven mutants, lineage contract, and routing in docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr172_spec.yaml before executing any result.
Implement the battery and strict schema/recomputation logic under COMMON plus a deterministic scripts/codex_harness runner; import both named adapters read-only.
Add the registered PR-card test and mutation cases without editing either production adapter during PR-172.
If a clean relation fails, emit the blocked result required by the card rather than tuning a tolerance or repairing the adapter inside the COMMON-only card.
risks_and_kill_switches: The B m-reflection relation is convention-specific; source-hash drift or a convention change requires a new spec version before replay, not tolerance widening.
The axisymmetric-zero relation tests the current projector boundary with B=0; it does not test upstream E-to-B generation physics.
The CF4 rotation relation exercises the repository's current fiducial covariance implementation only; a pass cannot validate the physical power spectrum or Gorski model.
A nonzero clean residual above the frozen tolerance blocks that adapter. No post-result threshold tuning is allowed.
A mutation crash without a valid execution envelope is a survivor, not a kill.
PR-151 must be fast-probed at PR-172 closeout; terminal readiness changes only the next-card scheduling, not this atomic result.
artifacts_status_updates_needed: docs/codex_handoff/pr_status.yaml and its machine mirror only after the executed gate is terminal
assumptions: The production adapters remain byte-identical to the assignment bindings during implementation and execution.
The B-projector m-axis remains ordered [-2,-1,0,1,2], as stated and indexed in the bound source.
PR-172 keeps COMMON single-writer scope; failures in the read-only adapters are reported as blockers rather than silently repaired.
The implementation records actual runtime in an execution receipt but excludes only the frozen volatile telemetry fields from semantic replay hashing.
